fields.Name: Rubric Evaluator - Default Judge
fields.Description: The judge the LLM rubric evaluator uses when the link names none: an impartial reviewer who scores only against the criteria and anchors, takes the lower of two levels, and does not reward length or tone.

fields.Name: Rubric Judge - Research Agent
fields.Description: A rubric judge written for Research Agent runs: what a good run of that agent looks like and the mistakes to score down. Rendered into the Rubric Evaluator prompt's judgePrompt slot when an agent-rubric link names it in EvaluatorConfig.PromptName.
